scope: Procedurally blinded known-cipher recovery calibration, not Voynich decoding
training: Apicius books1-5 only, from pinned Latin bundle; Caesar books1-3 wholly withheld from solver inputs
normalization: Existing Latin bundle filter: drop first line, discard all-uppercase lines, lowercase, ASCII a-z word tokens joined with spaces; no u/v or i/j folding

packet.source: one private random passage per Caesar book1-3
packet.keys: private seeded random bijections; seed/truth commitment published before solve
packet.blinding: solver receives only public training text/ciphertexts; shared filesystem and preexisting source access mean procedural, not security isolation

model.training_counts: within each training book, not across book joins
model.score_quantization: round(1000*ln P(next|previous3)), signed int32; total score int64
model.table_policy: freeze and hash LM table before solving; no Caesar plaintext to LM

search.initialization: rank cipher symbol frequencies to training letter frequencies; restart0 untouched, other restarts apply12 random swaps
search.proposal: uniform distinct pair of cipher alphabet positions; swap decoding assignments
search.temperature: 100 fixed geometric stages from30000 to200 integer score units
search.acceptance: integer PRNG draw below frozen floor(exp(-bucket/256)*2^32), bucket=min(8192, floor(-delta*256/T)); accept nonnegative delta
search.polish: up to100 best improving swap updates, inspect all325 pairs per update
search.selection: maximum frozen language-model score only, before truth reveal
search.duplicate_policy: spaced/spaceless pairs have same stripped stream; cache identical streams, report as paired views not independent messages

development: Only a short deterministic substitution of training Apicius may be used for runtime/invariant checks; do not tune budget on hidden Caesar results
freeze: Hash solver manifest covering Python/C++ source, public packet, integer LM and acceptance tables, plus complete predictions before evaluator reveals metrics/keys/plaintext
metrics: key accuracy over OBSERVED cipher symbols
frozen LM score separated from truth
post-reveal true-key frozen-LM score versus candidate score to distinguish search failure from objective mismatch
gate: All3 independent monoalphabetic plaintexts and all their observed symbol mappings must be exactly recovered. Paired spacing views must agree. Failure blocks promoting this solver as adequate even for this chosen control family; success is not evidence that Voynich is Latin or monoalphabetic.
negative_interpretation: Solver always outputs a candidate; no posthoc abstention threshold. Randomized-text key recovery does not imply meaningful text. Roundtrip encryption is integrity, not proof of correct recovery.
